prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 18-cell grid body (9 rows, two columns), every cell a genuinely different material, every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Norwegian woman in Nordic valkyrie makeup — fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids and a braided crown, a fierce, steady, commanding expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a thick silver knotted hoop.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, body divided into a 18-cell grid (9 rows, two columns), each cell a different material, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 18 cells — 9 horizontal rows crossed by one vertical centre line — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell carved solid deep royal-blue lapis lazuli with golden pyrite flecks, completely opaque; right cell carved solid polished black obsidian with faint internal swirls, completely opaque. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque; right cell carved solid golden-brown tiger's eye with a silky chatoyant band, completely opaque. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell carved solid deep blue sodalite with fine white veining, completely opaque; right cell carved solid dark wenge wood with fine gold-tan pinstripes, completely opaque. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell carved solid vivid violet-purple purpleheart wood, completely opaque; right cell carved solid golden teak with fine straight grain, completely opaque. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell carved solid warm cream-to-tan olive wood with dark swirling grain, completely opaque; right cell carved solid vivid orange-red Osage orange wood, completely opaque. Row 6 (left / right body band 6): left cell carved solid dark chocolate-brown bocote wood with bold tiger-stripe patterns, completely opaque; right cell carved solid striking orange-red padauk wood, completely opaque. Row 7 (left / right body band 7): left cell carved solid richly streaked cream, rose-pink and violet Brazilian tulipwood, completely opaque; right cell carved solid deep black ebony with fine dense grain, completely opaque. Row 8 (left / right body band 8): left cell carved solid deep reddish-brown rosewood streaked with black, completely opaque; right cell clear turquoise water with drifting bubbles. Row 9 (left thigh-stub-stub tip / right thigh-stub-stub tip (just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate)): left cell clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals, sealing shut at its tip; right cell clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, sealing shut at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep forest green on one side and a soft blush pink on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so green light glances off one side and pink light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
